fullDescription: A 'Light & Hopeful' MedTech design system featuring a clean, optimistic aesthetic centered on Sage Green and Trustworthy Blue. It utilizes high-density whitespace, soft shadows, and organic blurred blobs to create an atmosphere of healing and innovation. Suitable for healthcare startups, clinical platforms, biotechnology, wellness applications, and high-trust SaaS. The layout features bento-style grids, staggered animations, and professional data visualization components.
prompt:
## Resumo
A luminous and professional MedTech design system utilizing a pure white background with Sage Green (#4A9D7E) and Soft Blue (#5B8FC4) accents. It combines clinical precision with human-centric warmth through airy layouts, soft shadows, and high-quality typography (Poppins and Inter).

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a 'Light & Hopeful MedTech' aesthetic. **Colors**: Pure white background (#FFFFFF); Primary Accent Sage Green (#4A9D7E, hover #6DB899); Secondary Accent Soft Blue (#5B8FC4); Text Dark Slate (#2C3E50); Muted Text (#6B7280); Border Light Grey (#E5E7EB). **Typography**: Headings in Poppins (Bold, -0.03em tracking); Body in Inter (Regular/Medium, 1.7 line-height). **Components**: Cards with 16px border-radius, 1px solid #E5E7EB, and soft shadow (0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)). **Background**: Use subtle radial dot patterns (1px dots, 28px spacing) and large, organic blurred blobs (filter: blur(70px), opacity 10%) in sage and blue. **Animations**: Implement 'fade-up' entrance effects (transform: translateY(20px), opacity 0 to 1) with 0.6s easing and staggered delays (0.1s intervals).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky Navigation
A 64px height sticky header with a solid white background and a 1px bottom border (#E5E7EB). Left side contains a logo with a 32px rounded-xl gradient icon and brand text (17px Poppins Bold). Right side features 13px weight 500 navigation links and a compact Primary CTA button.

### Hero Section
Split layout (7:12 grid). Background features a light gradient from #F0FAF5 to #FFFFFF. Left side contains a pill-shaped tag, a large heading (size: 68px, line-height: 1.08), and a descriptive paragraph. Below the text, a stats row with 30px bold numbers separated by 1px vertical dividers. Right side features a prominent floating card (box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(74,157,126,0.12)) containing an illustrative graphic and a 2x2 grid of icon-based benefit pills.

### Statistics and Problems Grid
A section with a clear tag label. Features a 3-column grid of cards where each card highlights a large number (48px Poppins) followed by a 14px semi-bold title. Below the grid, include a full-width callout box with a 3px blue left border and a light blue background tint (#5B8FC4 at 10% opacity) for key quotes or insights.

### Comparison and Trust Table
A clean data table with rounded corners (16px). Header cells use a light grey background (#F0F4F2), 11px uppercase text, and 0.08em tracking. The primary comparison column is highlighted with a faint Sage Green background (5% opacity). Rows feature hover states (#F8FAF9) and use color-coded status dots: Green (#4A9D7E), Yellow (#D97706), and Red (#DC2626).

### Step-by-Step Phases
A 4-column horizontal grid. Each phase is a card with a large background watermark number (48px, Poppins Bold, color: #E5E7EB). Top-left features a 44px icon container with a soft sage glow. Content includes a 15px bold title and 12px muted body text with 1.7 line-height.

### Interactive Roadmap Timeline
A vertical list layout where each row is a grid (90px date | 130px label | 1fr content). The 'current' status row is highlighted with a solid 4px sage left-border and a soft green tint background. The 'future/exit' row uses a different background tint to signify completion.

### Footer
A minimalist 32px padding footer with a top border. Background #F8FAF9. Features the brand logo on the left, a centered copyright string in 12px muted text, and a horizontal list of text links on the right.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Sage Pill Tag — A high-visibility status badge.
Create a pill-shaped badge with 11px uppercase bold text. Background: var(--accent-glow) (Sage at 10% opacity). Border: 1px solid Sage (20% opacity). Text color: #4A9D7E. Include a small 14px icon to the left of the text with 6px spacing.

### Primary Button — High-impact rounded button with hover transform.
A 100px rounded button with background #4A9D7E and white text. Font: 15px Poppins Bold. Padding: 14px 32px. Micro-interaction: On hover, background shifts to #6DB899, translateY(-2px), and adds a Sage-colored drop shadow (0 8px 24px rgba(74,157,126,0.30)).

### Data Card Inner — A subtle nested container for grouping data within a card.
A container with 12px border-radius, background color #F0F4F2, and a 1px solid #E5E7EB border. Used for internal lists or secondary information groups within a larger card.

style.description: The style is defined by its 'healing' palette and 'breathable' spacing. It uses a pure white base (#FFFFFF) with off-white and mint-tinted section alternates (#F8FAF9, #F0F4F2). Typography is a high-contrast pairing of Poppins for bold, geometric headings and Inter for high-readability body text. Visual depth is achieved through 70px blurred color blobs and a subtle 28px dot grid background.
